Alex / Jasmine — putting a more practical implementation checklist here so the kickoff can be focused: short bullets and ownership.

Pre-kickoff (this week)
- ClariHealth: Confirm test account credentials and provide a small corpus of ~50 representative records for schema edge cases. Owner: Alex / Nadia.
- Redwood: Stand up sandbox endpoint (region: us-west-2), ensure streaming enabled, attach sample config. Owner: Marissa.

Sprint 0 (week 1)
- Map events to Redwood structured-output schema; run validator and produce mismatch report. (Artifacts: validator-report.md, schema-samples.json)
- Agree on function call verbs and sample callback payloads.
- Provide recommended batching and KV-cache strategy for the clinical note length (expect avg 1.2k tokens).

Sprint 1 (week 2-3)
- Run live tests in sandbox, collect logs via our tracing hook, iterate on prompt templates.
- Performance tuning: target p50 <= 300ms when using the reserved model for short outputs (note summaries).

Go/no-go criteria for pilot start:
- Schema mismatches < 5 for top-level fields.
- SOW signed and test credentials verified.
- Function-call contract validated with 3 successful end-to-end callbacks.

Attachments I'll add to the kickoff doc: redwood-implementation-checklist.pdf and a small template for the function-call contract.

Soojin — can you own the runbook section about streaming timeouts and fallback routing? I'll coordinate the evaluation prompts.

Thanks,
